The key fact about "50th Anniversary" is how its nine prize levels are built. The prize money leans toward many smaller prizes. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. Prize counts change daily, but this design does not.

If "50th Anniversary" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
827.headline: Where the prize money is

847.body:
The $500,000 top prize on "Bingo 50X" is no longer available because all four have been claimed. The biggest prize anyone can win today is $100,000. Use that amount when you decide.

Today's free summary of "Bingo 50X" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
847.headline: No top prizes remain

891.body:
The most common win left on "Cash Explosion 25X" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and one of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything above about "Cash Explosion 25X" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
